title: Kithogue
html_source:
“Kithogue” is Hiberno-English for “left-handed” from the Irish ciotóg. The connotation here is “unlucky” or “strange” much like “sinister” (from the Latin “sinistra” meaning “left”). Compare this with the line below:

“A sinister figure leans on plaited legs against O'Beirnes wall…”
